ontology:
Prefix(:=<http://example.org/diff011#>)
Ontology(<http://example.org/diff011>
  IrreflexiveObjectProperty(:irr)
  AsymmetricObjectProperty(:asym)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:irr :y :y)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:asym :a :b)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:asym :b :a)
)
rationale: SROIQ RBox violations: IrreflexiveObjectProperty(irr) forbids irr(y,y) (asserted), and AsymmetricObjectProperty(asym) forbids having both asym(a,b) and asym(b,a) (asserted). Either violation alone makes the ontology inconsistent.
